claim: Tempelhofer Feld has a 6 km cycling/skating/jogging trail, a 2.5-hectare BBQ area, and the 45m-wide former runways are open for cycling, skating, kite surfing, and wind sports
quote: On Tempelhofer Feld, there is plenty of free space for cycling, skating, Segway, windsports... a six-kilometre cycling, skating and jogging trail, a 2.5-hectare BBQ area

claim: Tempelhofer Feld is a former airport now Berlin's largest open-air park with sunset crowds, allotment gardens, and Mobilcenter pedal-bike/go-kart rentals on the runways
quote: Mobilcenter Berlin operates a pedal bike, pedal, go-kart and bicycle rental service, with more than 70 seats on pedal mobiles and enough comfortable bikes and tandems to explore the field and its 45 m wide runways

claim: Mauerpark flea market runs Sundays 10:00-18:00 with fashion, vinyl, furniture, and home decorations; entry is free
quote: fashion, jewelry, bags, furniture, home decorations and vinyl records as well as snacks and drinks

claim: Joe Hatchiban has run Mauerpark's open-air Bearpit Karaoke every Sunday at 15:00 since 2009, weather permitting, April-October
quote: Joe Hatchiban has been bringing his battery-powered karaoke system to the Mauerpark every Sunday since 2009. Providing the weather is good, he'll be there from 15:00

claim: Markthalle Neun's Street Food Thursday runs every Thursday 17:00-22:00 in Kreuzberg, featuring Thai dumplings, tacos, ceviche, Korean buns and Berlin's diverse food scene
quote: every Thursday from 5 p.m. to 10 p.m., Markthalle Neun becomes a platform for chefs without their own restaurant

claim: Stern und Kreisschiffahrt is Berlin's largest passenger shipping company offering 30 different Spree tours from numerous jetties, including a classic 1-hour historic-city cruise and a 3-hour bridge cruise
quote: Berlin's largest shipping company, with 30 different tours and numerous jetties

claim: Reederei Riedel is Berlin's second-largest passenger shipping line and offers Spree cruises past landmark architecture and a 3-hour Bridges Tour through river banks and elevated railway sections
quote: Reederei Riedel is Berlin's second-largest passenger shipping company

claim: The 69m Siegessäule in the center of Tiergarten has a viewing platform reached via 285 steps; open in summer 09:30-19:00, admission roughly €4
quote: After climbing the 285 steps to the top, visitors are rewarded with a great view over the Tiergarten and the nearby Bellevue Palace

claim: Tiergarten is best approached on foot via the 20-minute walk from Brandenburg Gate; the park's Cafe am Neuen See and Schleusenkrug beer gardens are recommended stops
quote: Perhaps one of the nicest ways to approach the Victory Column is to enjoy the 20 minute walk from Brandenburg Gate where the column is in full view as you approach it

claim: The Soviet War Memorial in Treptower Park is the largest Red Army monument in Germany, commemorating 7,000 of the 80,000 soldiers killed in the April-May 1945 Battle of Berlin; opened 8 May 1949
quote: the largest monument to the fallen soldiers of the Red Army in Germany. It was built to commemorate 7,000 of the 80,000 Red Army soldiers who fell in the Battle of Berlin

claim: Alternative Berlin runs tip-based 3-hour street-art and counterculture walking tours through Friedrichshain, Mitte and Kreuzberg covering graffiti, squats, techno history and Haus Schwarzenberg
quote: explores the raw and creative heart of Berlin in neighborhoods like Friedrichshain, Mitte, and Kreuzberg

claim: Wannsee (S1 to Nikolassee) has 1,275m of sandy beach and is the classic Berlin summer escape; Müggelsee in the southeast covers 7.4 km² and Strandbad Müggelsee admission is now free
quote: Wannsee has been favorite hot weather getaway for Berliners for over 100 years! For starters, it has over 1275 meters of sandy beaches

claim: Volkspark Friedrichshain is Berlin's oldest public park at 52 hectares, on the border of Friedrichshain and Prenzlauer Berg, and contains the 1913 Märchenbrunnen with 106 fairy-tale sculptures
quote: Volkspark Friedrichshain is a large urban park on the border of the Berlin neighborhoods of Friedrichshain and Prenzlauer Berg... oldest public park in Berlin

claim: Boxhagener Platz flea market runs every Sunday 10:00-18:00 in Friedrichshain's Simon-Dach-Strasse quarter with second-hand clothes, books, records, paintings and furniture
quote: Every Sunday a large flea market is held on the Boxhagener Platz, located in the heart of the vibrant student quarter around Simon-Dach-Strasse

claim: KaDeWe's 6th-floor gourmet food hall has sold international delicacies since 1956, offering Kobe beef, oysters, truffle cheese and champagne/oyster bars with no admission fee
quote: Delicacies from all over the world have been sold here since 1956... Whether Kobe beef, oysters or truffle cheese, there is hardly a wish that cannot be fulfilled

claim: Donkey Republic has been discontinued in Berlin; Nextbike and Deutsche Bahn's Call-a-Bike remain the primary bike-sharing options, with Nextbike charging €1 per 15 minutes capped at €15/day
quote: Donkey Republic no longer offers bikes for hire in Berlin

claim: Botanischer Garten Berlin (Dahlem) is open daily 10:00-20:00 April-September, with greenhouses and ticket desks 10:00-19:00; permanent museum exhibition closed for renovation until ~2025
quote: the cash desks and greenhouses are open from 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM, and the garden/exits are open from 10:00 AM – 8:00 PM

claim: Berlin in June averages a high of 23.1°C and a low of 12.9°C with 9.3 sunshine hours per day; sunset reaches ~21:32 by month's end, giving long evening daylight
quote: In June, the average high-temperature is 23.1°C (73.6°F), and the average low-temperature is 12.9°C (55.2°F)
